title: Celebrity Gauntlet — city rooftop
notes: Original generated background, copied unchanged. Runtime canvas covers the viewport and aligns the foot-contact line at world y=548. No artwork from existing games was used.
prompt: Create one polished original background for a premium 2D chibi arcade fighting game called Celebrity Gauntlet. BACKGROUND ONLY, absolutely no people, fighters, letters, words, logos, interface, or frame. Wide landscape 16:9 composition, as close to 1536x864 as possible. Side-on rooftop arena high above a dense modern American city at blue hour just after sunset. Art direction: beautifully hand-painted crisp stylized 2.5D fighting-game environment, confident clean architectural linework, rich deep indigo and blue with warm amber windows and restrained magenta/cyan reflected highlights, impressive detailed layered skyline with atmospheric depth, several distinctive skyscrapers, believable masonry and glass, sweeping violet clouds, a small crescent moon. This is unmistakably a real BUILDING ROOFTOP, not a futuristic grid or concert stage. A broad flat weathered concrete roof occupies the bottom 30 percent of the image. A low concrete-and-brick parapet runs straight and level behind the whole fighting area, its bottom at exactly 70 percent image height. The empty playable foot-contact strip is at 76 percent image height; keep it level across the entire width. Foreground concrete continues all the way off the bottom edge with subtle wide perspective seams, tiny texture and a few soft damp reflections. No foreground objects or front roof lip. At the far left, behind the arena, a classic small cylindrical water tank on a metal stand; far right, behind the arena, a compact brick rooftop stairwell and a low ventilation unit with pipes, antennas and a few warm practical lights. All rooftop equipment must stay behind the parapet or tightly at the extreme sides, with the central 80 percent completely open for fighters. Avoid any large object, rail or furniture across the fight floor. Camera at fighter eye level with a slightly elevated view of the broad roof surface, almost orthographic side-view composition. City towers remain crisp but lower contrast behind the fighters. Generous uncluttered upper sky for game health bars. Rich professional production art, textured and dimensional, visually exciting without visual clutter. No black side borders, no vignette, no dramatic tilt, no fisheye.
